product.description:
The Mother’s Encyclopedia — Four-Volume Partial Set, 1953

A mid-century illustrated parenting reference compiled and edited by the editors of Parents’ Magazine. The matching brown cloth bindings feature decorative gilt spine designs.

Condition

Well-used vintage hardcovers with rubbing and fading to the cloth and gilt, worn corners, and fraying at spine ends. Pages show age toning and foxing/brown spotting. Volume four has folded/creased corners on its preliminary leaves. The books have not been inspected page by page; interior completeness and binding strength have not been fully checked. No dust jackets. Please review all photographs.

Details

  • 1953 printing; copyright pages also cite 1933 and 1942
  • Compiled and edited by the Editors of Parents’ Magazine
  • Publisher: The Parents’ Institute, Inc., New York
  • English-language cloth hardcovers; printed in the United States
  • Approximate comparable-copy size: 7¼ × 5 × 1 inch per book; not individually measured
  • Historical reference and collectible; parenting and medical content reflects its period

Included

Four books only: volumes ONE, FOUR, FIVE and SIX. Volumes TWO and THREE are NOT included. This is an incomplete four-volume lot from the original six-volume series.

Packing & Shipping

Books protected against moisture and packed together in a sturdy box with protective cushioning. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
